description: Local-first, versioned memory hub & Python SDK for AI agents. Share evolving facts, profiles & coding procedures across 18 tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw...) — no SaaS lock-in, zero-server Git sync, #1 on LoCoMo / LongMemEval / PersonaMem-v2.
summary: All your agents. One memory. Layered, versioned long-term memory for LLM agents, shared across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more. 让你的所有AI工具共享一份长期记忆：分层整理、版本演化，偏好变了也记得准。
